provenance: Shard rajab-a30: the proofs al-Mughnī and Ibn Rajab's record cite for each position of q085.f008, weighed under docs/architecture/taarud-reconciliation.md §redesign (tiers per Rawḍa v02 p389–390); every excerpt located verbatim in the pinned witness. No human review yet.

proofs.dalil: ʿUmar ordered Muḥammad b. Maslama to let al-Ḍaḥḥāk b. Khalīfa run his channel through his land, since it benefited him and did him no harm.
proofs.excerpt_ar: فقال له عمر: لم تمنع أخاك ما ينفعه، وهو لك نافع، تشربه أولا وآخرا؟ فقال محمد: لا والله. فقال عمر: والله ليمرن به
proofs.note: al-Mughnī's proof for the riwāya of permission (position 0), from Mālik's Muwaṭṭaʾ and Saʿīd's Sunan. In the same passage it is contradicted by Muḥammad b. Maslama's own word, so a ṣaḥābī view where the ṣaḥāba disagreed: aqrabSahabi.

proofs.dalil: ʿUmar's judgement in the case is the ground of the riwāya that the need establishes the right.
proofs.excerpt_ar: إجراء الماء في أرض غيره إذا اضطر إلى ذلك في إحدى الروايتين لقضاء عمرته
proofs.note: The record itself names the judgement («لقضاء عمرته», so the witness) as the riwāya's ground. Same ṣaḥābī view, disputed by Muḥammad b. Maslama: aqrabSahabi.

proofs.dalil: It is disposing of another's land without his leave, so it is barred, as where no compulsion calls for it; such need does not make another's property lawful, as it does not make lawful sowing or building in it.
proofs.excerpt_ar: إحداهما، لا يجوز؛ لأنه تصرف في أرض غيره بغير إذنه، فلم يجز، كما لو لم تدع إليه ضرورة
proofs.note: An analogy with the case without compulsion, so qiyas.

proofs.dalil: Muḥammad b. Maslama, a ṣaḥābī, refused, and his word opposes ʿUmar's.
proofs.excerpt_ar: والأول أقيس، وقول عمر يخالفه قول محمد بن مسلمة، وهو موافق للأصول، فكان أولى
proofs.note: al-Mughnī sets Muḥammad b. Maslama's word against ʿUmar's. The ground it adds, «وهو موافق للأصول», is agreement with the uṣūl, a qiyās-domain advantage that does not weigh ṣaḥābī views; no advantage is recorded.
